title: Asymptotic i.i.d. prophet inequalities: fixed-capacity limits and certified two-unit bounds
description: Candidate research manuscript and reproducibility package, version 0.1.0-candidate. For each fixed positive selection capacity, the manuscript establishes the worst-case i.i.d. prophet limit and a continuum minimax characterization. Rational witnesses and interval arithmetic certify 0.83695 <= gamma_2 <= 0.8372914 for two selections only, with strict separation from the specified nonlinear-system value. Original prose and data are CC0-1.0; original executable code is MIT. Targeted AI-assisted mathematical re-review and bound-PDF QA are complete; these are not human peer review, formal verification or publication approval.
